segments.text: You have reached the end of the Alpha build.

Thank you for spending time within the Kethaneum, Archivist.

What you have seen so far is only a fragment—a beginning. The systems you explored, the stories you uncovered, and the struggles you noticed are part of a larger whole still taking shape.

Your presence matters.

Every puzzle completed, every story read (or skipped), every moment of attention contributes to this realm. Chronicles of the Kethaneum is being shaped with care and room for reflection. Because no story is just a story. Know that your presence here is also part of that process.

In time, more stories will reveal themselves.
More patterns will emerge.
And not all answers will arrive at once.

For now, thank you for listening.

What has happened so far will matter later.
May you return and keep the witness...
